_about: Inbox inventory and health alerts for Blueprint M2. Generated by jobs/inbox_inventory.py from live Instantly reads; never edited by hand. role: active (in the email_list of a SENDING campaign), warming (< 21 days), idle (warm-up done and in no sending campaign, the pool promote_insurance picks from), retired (not status 1: paused, disconnected, erroring or half-built). Health alerts only: this file carries no reserve count and no buying advice.
_reply_rate_note: reply_rate_7d = unique_replies / sent. replies_automatic is a SEPARATE counter in GET /accounts/analytics/daily, not a subset of replies (2026-09-19: replies=0, replies_automatic=7 across the twelve active inboxes), so it is never subtracted.

ramp_plan._rule: 25/day now. 30/day from 2026-11-01 only for an inbox whose 7-day real reply rate is at least 2.00%, recomputed from that week's data on the day. Warm-up stays on forever, on every inbox, including retired ones.
